note: Every src module with no production or operator entry point must appear here with a reason. A module reachable only from tests is not reachable: the suite proves it behaves and proves nothing about whether anything can call it. Three modules were found dead by accident in one session (#88 mesh entry point, #100 occurrence compiler, the operator escalation kernel); this file plus tests/reachability-ratchet.test.mjs make the fourth one fail a gate instead.

categories.AWAITING_ACTIVATION: Implemented and gated. Deliberately not wired because wiring it without the named external gate would be unsafe or meaningless.
categories.SUPERSEDED: Replaced by another module. Kept only until its history is no longer useful.
categories.UNREACHABLE_BUG: Should be reachable and is not. This is a defect, not a decision.
categories.NEEDS_TRIAGE: Nobody has decided yet. Honest placeholder, not a resting state: an entry may sit here while archaeology is pending, but it may not be moved to AWAITING_ACTIVATION without a registered gate that states what would release it.

SANDBOX_PROVISIONER_EXTERNAL_BLOCK.description: The autonomous engineering path needs an attestation, from outside this process, that the sandbox it runs code in is network-isolated. The provisioner exists and is tested; what is missing is the external attestation, which this process cannot produce about itself.
SANDBOX_PROVISIONER_EXTERNAL_BLOCK.releasedBy: An operator-supplied isolation attestation that the provisioner can verify at construction time, after which the durable executor may be reached from an entry point.

NO_GMAIL_READONLY_GRANT.description: Inbound sensing reads a real mailbox. No read-only Gmail grant has been issued to this system, so there is no mailbox to read.
NO_GMAIL_READONLY_GRANT.releasedBy: A read-only Gmail grant recorded as durable authorization evidence, plus at least one real inbound message observed through it.

NO_COMMERCIAL_EVENTS.description: Causal attribution binds signals, sends, payments and deliveries into outcomes. Every one of those inputs is currently zero, so the spine would attribute nothing to nothing.
NO_COMMERCIAL_EVENTS.releasedBy: At least one real commercial event of any kind reaching durable storage.

NO_ENRICHMENT_PROVIDER.description: Prospect enrichment calls a third-party data provider. No enrichment provider is connected and no enrichment budget is authorized.
NO_ENRICHMENT_PROVIDER.releasedBy: An authorized enrichment provider with a funded, bounded budget recorded as durable authorization evidence.

NO_DISCOVERY_ADAPTER.description: Prospect discovery needs a source adapter that produces real, provenance-bearing profiles. Scoring logic exists and is tested; nothing feeds it.
NO_DISCOVERY_ADAPTER.releasedBy: A discovery adapter whose output carries source provenance strong enough to clear the evidence-class clamp.

NO_OUTBOUND_AUTHORIZATION.description: Every module behind this gate can, on its meaningful path, contact a real person. The owner has not authorized outbound contact. This is the gate whose accidental release is the most expensive mistake in the repository.
NO_OUTBOUND_AUTHORIZATION.releasedBy: Explicit, current owner authorization for outbound contact, bound to a named channel and audience, and re-checked immediately before each irreversible send.

NO_CUSTOMER.description: Service definition, fulfillment and retention model a customer relationship. There are zero verified customers, so there is no requirement to compile against and no delivery to accept.
NO_CUSTOMER.releasedBy: One verified customer with a recorded requirement.

VERCEL_DEPLOYMENT_GATED.description: Deployment tooling is operator-invoked and deliberately never triggered by application code. Reaching these from a production entry point is the failure mode, not the goal.
VERCEL_DEPLOYMENT_GATED.releasedBy: Nothing. This gate is permanent by design: these modules are operator tooling and should stay out of the production import graph.

NO_PAYMENT_PROVIDER.description: Payment-to-renewal truth derives economics from provider evidence. No payment provider is connected and no provider event has ever arrived.
NO_PAYMENT_PROVIDER.releasedBy: A connected payment provider and at least one real provider event in durable storage.

MESH_LIVE_OBSERVATION_REQUIRED.description: Self-upgrade composition is wirable, but wiring the mesh's self-modification path in the same pass that first made the mesh runnable is an unsafe ordering. Recorded in docs/AGENT_MESH_REACHABILITY_TRIAGE.md, not invented here.
MESH_LIVE_OBSERVATION_REQUIRED.releasedBy: Durable evidence of the agent mesh completing scheduler cycles in production, reviewed by the owner, before any path that can rewrite this repository is reachable.

NO_AI_ACCESS_EXTERNAL_AUTHORIZATION.description: The AI access catalogue's meaningful execution path creates provider accounts, applications and credit claims. Recorded as out of scope by the external-effect ledger in docs/AGENT_MESH_REACHABILITY_TRIAGE.md.
NO_AI_ACCESS_EXTERNAL_AUTHORIZATION.releasedBy: Separate, explicit owner authorization for provider account creation and application submission, which is not covered by any authorization granted to date.

NO_PROVIDER_ADAPTER_CONFIGURED.description: These contracts define what a provider integration must prove before it may act -- idempotency key, reconciliation of an uncertain attempt, retry law, and a receipt. Each declares its own *_ADAPTER_NOT_CONFIGURED refusal and there is no configured adapter or credential behind any of them, so the meaningful path cannot execute. Releasing one means connecting that provider's adapter and credential, not writing more contract code.
NO_PROVIDER_ADAPTER_CONFIGURED.releasedBy: A configured adapter and credential for that provider category, supplied by the owner.

NO_CONFIGURED_EGRESS_ROUTES.description: The egress health pool selects among configured outbound routes and quarantines a route/target pair that comes back blocked. No egress routes are configured, so there is nothing to select among and nothing to quarantine. The module deliberately refuses fingerprint spoofing, CAPTCHA bypass and rotation intended to evade blocks, which is the reason it exists and not a reason it is reachable.
NO_CONFIGURED_EGRESS_ROUTES.releasedBy: At least one egress route configured for authorized public-evidence traffic, with the owner having authorized the traffic that would flow over it. Configuring a route does not by itself authorize what is sent through it.

NO_EXTERNAL_EFFECT_AUTHORIZATION.description: The OMNIA-V9 consequence-execution architecture: constitution and policy binding, authority reservation and transition, authorization-bound receipts and their stores, proof storage, the external-effect state machine, dispatcher, adapters and recovery. Every meaningful path through it ends in performing a real external effect and recording proof that it was authorized. No authority to perform an external effect has been issued, so there is nothing for it to execute and nothing to prove. Its lineage and test history are recorded in docs/INSTANTLY_RECONCILIATION.md; this is restored working code held closed, not abandoned code.
NO_EXTERNAL_EFFECT_AUTHORIZATION.releasedBy: A live constitution and policy bundle, an issued owner authority for a named effect class, and at least one configured provider adapter. Any one of those alone releases nothing.

NO_PARTNER_OR_REFERRAL_RELATIONSHIP.description: Partner fit, account overlap and referral accounting model a distribution relationship with another organization. There are no partners and no referral agreements, so every input to these modules would have to be invented.
NO_PARTNER_OR_REFERRAL_RELATIONSHIP.releasedBy: At least one real partner or referral relationship, with terms the owner has agreed to.

NO_OBJECT_STORAGE_ADAPTER.description: External object storage needs a configured private adapter and a credential path that has been separately reviewed. Neither exists. The contract is deliberately fail-closed: `adapterConfigured` must be literally true, and every other value -- absent, false, the string "true", 1, {} -- is refused, so an object write cannot be reached by an accident of truthiness.
NO_OBJECT_STORAGE_ADAPTER.releasedBy: A configured private object-storage adapter with a reviewed credential path, and an owner decision that artifacts may leave PostgreSQL at all. Configuring an adapter does not by itself authorize what is written through it.
